name: Lyo.FeatureFlags.Web.Components
tagline: Blazor switch list and show/hide wrapper for feature flags.
description: FeatureFlagPanel lists every flag's name and mode from the in-process snapshot. AllowEdit defaults to false. A switch sets that flag on or off through IFeatureFlagUpdater. A percentage or rules flag loses that targeting when the switch changes. FeatureFlagView renders its child only when IFeatureFlagService.IsEnabled is true. A missing service or a disabled flag renders nothing. Register AddFeatureFlags or AddFeatureFlagsFromConfiguration on the host.
features: **FeatureFlagPanel.** Read-only until AllowEdit is true. The switch is on only for mode On. A percentage or rules row says that switching replaces that flag with on or off.
**FeatureFlagView.** Takes Name, ChildContent, and an optional FeatureFlagContext. Null context is an anonymous caller.
